title: Culinary Culture
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of discussion/practical sessions)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and roles of culinary culture, and the relationship between culinary culture and tourism behavior.
Apply knowledge of culinary culture to business activities in the hospitality and tourism industry.
Understand and appreciate the cultural aspects of culinary traditions from various regions and countries.
Analyze and evaluate the impact of culinary culture on tourism trends and business practices.
Effectively present and discuss topics related to culinary culture and tourism.
Work effectively in groups to complete assignments and projects related to culinary culture.
Demonstrate a proactive and disciplined approach to learning and personal development.
Show respect for traditional cultural values and practices.

minimum_entry_skills.skill_name: Basic Understanding of Hospitality and Tourism
